<!-- GITHUB002-B PR-FIRST-TEMPLATE -->
## Summary

What problem does this change address, and what is the resulting behavior or
project-state change?

## Issue linkage

Leaf Issue completed by this PR:

- `Closes #...` / `Fixes #...` / `Resolves #...`, **only** if merge fully
  satisfies that Issue; or
- `Refs #...` when the Issue must remain open.

Parent/related work:

- `Refs #...`

Do not use a closing keyword for a parent merely because one child/slice lands.

## Scope and authority

List the important specification, design, documentation, or implementation
constraints that govern this change. Write `N/A` when genuinely not applicable.

## Local validation

List the exact focused/static/full checks run on the candidate branch and their
results. Do not describe skipped validation as passing validation.

## CI and merge readiness

GitHub Actions runs repository validation for the Pull Request. Do not treat this
PR as published until it is merged into `main`.

- [ ] Required CI/checks are green, or are still pending and this PR is not being merged yet.
- [ ] The branch is current enough to satisfy the repository's merge/freshness policy.
- [ ] Review conversations that block merge are resolved.

## Review

Describe meaningful review performed for substantive changes, including any
independent review context when applicable.

## AI assistance

Choose or describe the closest fit:

- [ ] none or incidental
- [ ] substantial
- [ ] fully generated
- [ ] other / explained below

Prompts, transcripts, token counts, and model-by-model logs are not required.

## Known limitations or deferred work

List anything deliberately left out, or write `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the applicable `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I started from current repository state rather than relying on an old SHA or historical behavior.
- [ ] I kept unrelated changes out of this Pull Request.
- [ ] I linked the correct leaf Issue and used closing keywords only when merge truly completes it.
- [ ] I referenced parents/related work without accidentally closing them.
- [ ] I ran and reported local validation appropriate to the change.
- [ ] I updated documentation/specification owners when the change requires it.
- [ ] I understand that opening this PR is not publication; merge into `main` is the publication event.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute the submitted material.
